releaseNotes:
1. Dual Independent POS Printers: Dedicated selection & test print for Receipt/Customer Bill Printer (Thermal 80mm/58mm) and Barcode/Label Sticker Printer (TSC, Zebra, TVS, Citizen).
2. Vector SVG Barcode Printing & Instant PDF: Replaced CSS div lines with high-definition vector SVG rects that never disappear in browser print preview or PDF export; added direct Download Barcode PDF button.
3. Compact Catalog 'Hide Photos' Mode: Clean toggle in Admin Hub Catalog & Stock toolbar to review items in ultra-fast compact table mode.
4. Clean Product Form & Direct Scanner Autofill: Removed preset image pickers and standalone scan buttons; physical USB barcode scanners automatically populate numbers on focus without layout disruption.
